meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 当孩子想听睡前故事或学成语时，Claude 会用亲切缓慢的语气（约 0.6 倍语速）全文讲解寓言故事或成语典故，并在需要时先给出 20 个故事列表让孩子选。
howto.when: 当用户说“我要听故事”、直接说出故事名或成语、或发送故事序号时触发。

say.note: Claude 会给出 20 个寓言故事列表
直接全文讲解这个故事
讲解这个成语的典故和用法

howto.what_en: For kids aged 3-12, Claude tells bedtime fables and idiom stories in a warm, slow voice (~0.6x speed). It can list 20 stories for choice, then narrate in full or explain meanings.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'I want to hear a story', naming a story or idiom, or sending a story number.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: Claude will show a list of 20 fables.

say_en.text: Tell me the story of 'The Crow and the Pitcher'
say_en.note: Claude narrates that story in full.
Claude explains the idiom's origin and usage.
